definitions.explanation: The ability to predict or anticipate future events or developments. Often used in the phrase {先見|せんけん}の{明|めい} (the wisdom of foresight).

examples.japanese: {先見|せんけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{明|めい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{投資家|とうしか}→投資家：16242_toushika⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{先見|せんけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{明|めい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。

⟦{創業者|そうぎょうしゃ}→創業者：29027_sougyousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{先見|せんけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{明|めい}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to the founder's foresight, the company was able to adapt to the changing times.

notes:
USAGE: Almost always used in the fixed phrase {先見|せんけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{明|めい} (the wisdom of foresight). Rarely used alone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先見|せんけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{明|めい} (foresight, prescience - the most common usage)
- {先見|せんけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{明|めい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧/⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (to have/lack foresight)
- {先見|せんけん}{性|せい} (foresightedness)

RELATED WORDS:
- {予見|よけん} (prediction, foresight)
- ⟦{見通|みとお}し→見通し：10566_mitooshi⟧ (outlook, prospect)
- ⟦{慧眼|けいがん}→慧眼：09115_keigan⟧ (discerning eye)
